name: serena
description: Serena's symbol-level code search and editing over language servers, as an MCP server, started in its ide context without memories, onboarding or a dashboard. Writes .serena/project.yml into each repository it activates and starts that repository's language servers, which may run its build scripts. Needs the serena CLI, which the installer installs with uv.

interface.shortDescription: Serena's symbol-level code search and editing over language servers, as an MCP server, started in it
